memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you.” (Ezekiel 36:26)

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
“Behold,” says Christ, “I make all things new.” What a wonder it truly is that a man should receive a new heart! Nature can replace limbs; trees can sprout branches again, but who has ever heard of a heart being made new?.
Charles Spurgeon reminds us that regeneration is not repair, but re-creation. Christ does not patch the old heart; He replaces it. The crucified and risen Savior places a new core within us, a new center of life, desire, and affection.
This new heart awakens new hungers, holiness instead of habit, obedience instead of resistance. What once pulled us downward now loses its power, because God has changed the very seat of our desires.
Tears over the past are understandable, but they are not the end. Look up to the cross. Say with faith, “Just as I am… O Lamb of God, I come.”
When a soul cries, “Make me a new creature,” Heaven responds. That prayer, spoken sincerely, marks the miracle of new birth.
( Took from charles spurgeon's meditations)

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “Regeneration is the greatest miracle God performs in man.” (C. H. Spurgeon)

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You for Your miraculous power. You have given me a new heart and a new spirit that have transformed me and empowered me to do Your will. I have everything I need to begin again, new in You. Amen.

recommended_book.quote: "If a man were bidden to sow a field, he could not excuse his neglect by saying that it would be useless to sow unless God caused the seed to grow. He would not be justified in neglecting tillage because the secret energy of God alone can create a harvest. No one is hindered in the ordinary pursuits of life by the fact that unless the Lord build the house they labor in vain that build it."
